D.t: Jack Reed leads by 39.3 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 167,551 votes; a one point swing is about 2,130 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +32.5 and D +46.6. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +33.9. Your best recent poll is Emerson College/WPRI at D +34.6; your worst is University of New Hampshire at D +20.3. 3 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Providence, a projected net 93,005 votes; Washington, a projected net 23,589 votes; Kent, a projected net 20,980 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
